tests.name: Rig: create owned unpiloted target and align sectors

data.sql: WITH moved_player AS (UPDATE players SET sector_id = 1 WHERE name = 'tow_operator_v3' RETURNING player_id, ship_id), moved_active AS (UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 1 WHERE ship_id = (SELECT ship_id FROM moved_player)), new_ship AS (INSERT INTO ships (name, type_id, sector_id, holds, fighters, shields) VALUES ('Tow Target V3', 2, 1, 10, 1, 1) RETURNING ship_id), new_owner AS (INSERT INTO ship_ownership (ship_id, player_id, role_id, is_primary) SELECT n.ship_id, p.player_id, 1, TRUE FROM new_ship n CROSS JOIN moved_player p RETURNING ship_id) SELECT ship_id FROM new_owner;
